description: Expected-reward interval MDP validating IMPaCT's robust expected reward (Iyengar 'Robust Dynamic Programming', Math OR 2005; Nilim & El Ghaoui, Oper Res 2005; interval reward resolved by O-maximization, Givan-Leach-Dean AIJ 2000).
provenance: Exact by hand. s0 --(1,1)--> s1 ; s1 --> s2[0.5,1.0] (target) or s1[0.0,0.5] ; rewards r(s0)=1, r(s1)=2. REACHABILITY reward (gamma=1): pess=Rmaxmin (nature leaves s1 asap, p(s1)=0) => V1=2, V0=3 ; opt=Rmaxmax (nature stays, p(s1)=0.5) => V1=2/(1-0.5)=4, V0=5. DISCOUNTED reward (gamma=0.9): pess => V1=2, V0=1+0.9*2=2.8 ; opt => V1=2/(1-0.45)=3.6364, V0=1+0.9*3.6364=4.2727.

measured.note: Live runs 2026-07-01. IMPaCT matches PRISM (reachability reward) and IntervalMDP.jl (discounted reward) and the analytic/Iyengar values.

storm.note: interval reward ignores --uncertainty-resolution; returns only the nature-max value 4.999996 (= opt); Rmin unsupported
